terms.name: Orch
terms.definition: raj's coordinating Autolith agent. It handles priorities across projects and requests for raj's attention.

sources.quote: Orch is the coordinating agent. It handles priorities across projects and requests for raj's attention.

terms.name: Autolith
terms.definition: The conversational working environment raj uses for code, files, and processes. The October 2026 setup log describes it as running in a live Common Lisp image.

sources.quote: Autolith runs in a live Common Lisp image. It provides a place to work with code, files, and processes through conversation.

terms.name: HMAS
terms.definition: Hierarchical multi-agent systems: agents organized in layers. The November 2026 log introduces the term while discussing David J. Moore's taxonomy and its possible use in raj's personal work.

sources.quote: Hierarchical multi-agent systems (HMAS) organize agents in layers. He is considering how to apply those ideas to personal work.

terms.name: machine head
terms.definition: An agent responsible for execution and resources on one machine in the proposed cross-machine organization. The November 2026 log describes this organization as work still to implement and test.

sources.quote: A head is the agent responsible for execution and resources on one machine.
The proposed organization of machine heads still needs implementation and tests.

terms.name: project agent
terms.definition: An agent that keeps context for its own project. In the November 2026 design, persistence means that it can resume work, not that it must run inference continuously.

sources.quote: Persistent project agents keep the context for their own projects. They can communicate directly instead of requiring raj to repeat each report. Persistence means that an agent can resume its work. It does not require continuous inference.

terms.name: concept tree
terms.definition: raj's study outline: a tree of concepts and their constituent sub-concepts. He first works toward understanding its parts, then reviews how they affect each other's meaning.

sources.quote: A tree data structure to represent concepts and recursing to the leaf nodes (constituent sub-concepts) that i comprehend is the first step i take towards breaking down a larger problem.
Next is a context-aware pass of the tree as a whole. That is, not just understanding the nodes independently but enriching what they mean given the other nodes in the tree.

terms.name: PCA
terms.definition: In the blog map, the projection of centered post vectors onto at most two principal components. The displayed retained variance measures projection fidelity, not semantic accuracy.

sources.quote: For $n\ge1$ posts, stack $v_i^\top$ as rows of $X\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times768}$, ordered by slug. Store vectors as float32; compute centered PCA in float64, subtracting the first row before the mean to preserve small differences:
For $k=\min(2,n-1)$, the map coordinates are $Y=C V_k=U_k\Sigma_k$; missing coordinates are zero.
This measures projection fidelity, not semantic accuracy; with more posts, 2D distances can lose information.

terms.name: Lem
terms.definition: The terminal editor raj chose for Lisp work on the VPS. His setup uses the ncurses build with Vim bindings.

sources.quote: raj chose the ncurses build of Lem instead of Emacs for Lisp editing. The Lem setup includes Vim bindings.
This provides a terminal editor beside Autolith.

terms.name: Simplified Technical English
terms.definition: The writing style specified for raj's agent logs. The October 2026 setup log requires short sentences that retain material decisions and results.

sources.quote: New prose uses Simplified Technical English. Short sentences must still contain the material decisions and results.
Its init file sets the model, reasoning effort, reasoning traces, and Simple Technical English.
